title: Croatian Chili
description: Hearty, comforting Mexican-inspired stew made with Croatian sausage and a blend of spices.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced Croatian sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the crushed canned diced tomatoes, chili powder, cumin, and salt.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Return the browned sausage to the pot and stir in the bake beans.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro (optional).
